summary.text: Cara Pavalock-D'Amato has represented Connecticut's 77th House District since January 2015 and is the Republican candidate for the seat on the November 3, 2026 ballot.

paragraphs.text: She attended St. Paul Catholic High School in Bristol, earned a bachelor's degree from Providence College and a law degree from St. Thomas University School of Law, and received a Master of Laws in taxation from Georgetown University Law Center.
She then returned to Bristol and became a solo practitioner in family law, bankruptcy and foreclosure defense.
